description: Source code for the RingBufferParcelable class, which handles parceling and memory setup for ring buffer data structures in Android's AAudio system.

classes.name: RingBufferParcelable
classes.description: A class that implements parceling and memory setup for RingBuffer objects in Android's AAudio system.

methods.name: RingBufferParcelable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parcelable object from a RingBuffer.

methods.name: parcelable
methods.description: Returns a RingBuffer object reconstructed from the parcelable data.

methods.name: setupMemory
methods.description: Configures shared memory regions for the ring buffer, counters, and data.

methods.name: getBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per audio frame.

methods.name: setBytesPerFrame
methods.description: Sets the number of bytes per audio frame.

methods.name: getFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Returns the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: setFramesPerBurst
methods.description: Sets the number of frames per burst.

methods.name: getCapacityInFrames
methods.description: Returns the capacity of the ring buffer in frames.

methods.name: setCapacityInFrames
methods.description: Sets the capacity of the ring buffer in frames.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves memory addresses for the ring buffer's counters and data.

methods.name: updateMemory
methods.description: Updates memory info based on another parcelable and a memory index map.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the ring buffer parameters for correctness.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Logs the current state of the ring buffer parcelable.
